title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of employers' organizations

description.narrative: The Jordan Chamber of Industry (JCI) established a new Labour market unit composed of a labour economist, a labour lawyer and two skills specialists. Through a dedicated website and online consultations, JCI provided information on how to comply with labour law and social security regulations including videos, infographics, and PPT. JCI also established a HR Managers’ network and organized meetings on labour related matters. More than 200 queries were received, and advice provided. Most queries related to workers termination, social security, and a new employment programme with incentives for firms hiring new people. According to JCI management, member companies appreciate the new service, and it has potential to expand further including to integrate people with disabilities. At the same time, JCI has piloted a new service enabling them to conduct rapid productivity assessment at company level focused on measuring working conditions and four productivity levers: sales revenue, output per unit cost of production, labour utilization and capital utilization. JCI piloted the methodology in 30 SMEs and supported the implementation of productivity enhancement plans in 15 SMEs. The methodology meets the needs of Jordan’s key industrial sectors and is the basis for a new company service with the potential for becoming a paid JCI service. The outcome will seek to make these services sustainable and support JCI to have a more solid financial income.
